# Hume AI Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill for Hume AI: synthesize speech with the Octave TTS models and read EVI (Empathic Voice Interface) conversational configs. Live EVI sessions run over WebSocket and are outside scope; EVI config changes and cloned voices are confirmation-gated. Honest note: all usage is metered — every TTS call spends Hume credits, so the skill only synthesizes what you asked for; Hume offers a free tier. Note: EVI 1 and EVI 2 are retired — target EVI 3 or EVI 4-mini only. Draft: written from Hume's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
